sources.title: Relic Abundance of Dark Photon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can energy initially stored in a misaligned axion produce the observed abundance of very light massive-vector dark matter through tachyonic amplification, including masses far below those efficiently populated by inflationary fluctuations?

sources.title: Relic Abundance of Dark Photon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Solve the coupled nonlinear field equations on a periodic 128³ cubic lattice with initial comoving spacing π/(512ma), using vacuum-seeded Fourier fluctuations with Rayleigh amplitudes. The supplement specifies staggered leapfrog evolution and centered spatial differences with second-order accuracy.

sources.title: Relic Abundance of Dark Photon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Linearize around a homogeneous oscillating axion and decompose transverse vector modes by helicity. One helicity has negative effective frequency squared near k/a≈β|φ̇|/(2fa) when mγ′<β|φ̇|/(2fa), identifying the tachyonic production band.

sources.title: Dark Photon Dark Matter Produced by Axion Oscillations

evidence.text: Can coherent axion oscillations produce cold dark-photon dark matter through a tachyonic instability while visible-sector interactions eliminate the residual axion without violating cosmological constraints?

membershipSample.placementReason: Explicitly targets misalignment-fed tachyonic production of very light vector dark matter below the efficient reach of the compared inflationary mechanism.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q8 covers the complete production and low-mass comparison target more specifically than q9 or q19. The vector remains the final relic and the axion the energy donor. The benchmark and mass ratio remain scenario-specific, without importing another construction's residual-axion depletion or a conjectural limitation of the comparison mechanism.

destination.title: Axion cosmology, observable signatures and gravitational consistency
destination.question: How do axion potentials, production histories and interactions shape cosmology and observable signals, and what source-specific gravitational or ultraviolet conditions constrain these models?
destination.summary: A proposed family of related questions spanning ordinary axion phenomenology, multiple-field models and conditional quantum-gravity tests. Different dark-matter species, cosmic epochs, local-gravity regimes and effective-theory conventions remain separate.

systems: QCD axions, axion-like particles and multiple-axion theories
Axions coupled to dilatons, other moduli, gauge fields or Standard Model fields
Adjacent vector-dark-matter, scalar-tensor and compactification settings
targets: Relic abundances, inflation, vacuum structure and dark energy
Expansion histories, radiation, structure and detection signals
Force screening, effective field ranges and conditional ultraviolet consistency
regimes: Inflation, reheating, BBN, recombination and late cosmology
Nonlinear dark-matter structures, local gravity and neutron stars
Source-specific effective theories and a fixed-five-dimensional weak-coupling boundary case
assumptions: Assumptions belong to individual questions; numerical proximity supplies none.
Weak Gravity Conjecture conditions apply only where explicitly considered.
Historical observational reports remain dated motivations or comparison data.
conventions: Preserve each source's field normalization, Planck scale and distinction between fundamental and effective decay constants.
A source-scoped singleton preserves its original statement without asserting atomicity or cross-source uniqueness.
includes: Methods, speculative targets and explicitly incomplete investigations
excludes: A universal axion mass window, production mechanism or quantum-gravity premise

sources.title: Drifting Oscillations in Axion Monodromy

evidence.text: When does secular drift of oscillation frequency invalidate fixed-period searches for axion-monodromy signatures, and which templates can capture this drift in CMB analyses?

sources.title: Lattice QCD and Axion Cosmology

evidence.text: How can the finite-temperature topological susceptibility constrain the cosmological axion abundance and present-day axion mass, and what experimental guidance can a preliminary pure-glue lattice calculation provide?

sources.title: Axion Cosmology

evidence.text: How do axion models, production histories and field dynamics connect to cosmological observations, particularly constraints on ultralight axions produced by vacuum realignment?

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signatures from Warm Dark Energy

evidence.text: The shared setting tests whether transfer of energy from a homogeneous axion into gauge fields can provide extra friction during the transition from matter domination to acceleration.

sources.title: Detection of isotropic cosmic birefringence and its implications for axionlike particles including dark energy

evidence.text: Can an axion-like particle explain the historically reported isotropic CMB birefringence while contributing dark matter, thawing dark energy, or early dark energy, and what conditional parameter bounds follow?

sources.title: Axi-Higgs cosmology

evidence.text: Can an axion-driven, approximately 1% increase of the Higgs vacuum expectation value during BBN and recombination alleviate the lithium, Hubble and S8 tensions while explaining the then-reported isotropic cosmic birefringence?

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence and electroweak axion dark energy

evidence.text: Can an electroweak-instanton axion simultaneously explain quintessence dark energy and the historically reported CMB polarization rotation, while satisfying anomaly cancellation, perturbativity and equation-of-state constraints?

sources.title: Kination cosmology from scalar fields and gravitational-wave signatures

evidence.text: Can axion dynamics produce an intermediate kination era after reheating, and can its gravitational-wave signatures probe the expansion history, axion dark matter and baryogenesis?

sources.title: Constraints on early dark energy from the axion weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion models of early dark energy be embedded in quantum gravity, and how strongly does the axion weak gravity conjecture constrain their decay constants and cosmologically relevant energy fractions?

sources.title: Some open questions in axion theory

evidence.text: How can quantized axion couplings be measured, monopole-induced potentials be computed reliably, post-inflationary axion dark matter be predicted, and thermal friction be understood across cosmological regimes?

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence from monodromic axion dark energy

evidence.text: Can a single monodromic axion account for dark energy and isotropic cosmic birefringence while keeping its fundamental decay constant below the Planck scale?

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence from monodromic axion dark energy

evidence.text: A homogeneous ultralight axion can act as potential-dominated dark energy and rotate photon polarization through a Chern–Simons interaction. Its mass and photon coupling are independent effective parameters.

sources.title: Light axiodilatons: matter couplings, weak-scale completions and long-distance tests of gravity

evidence.text: Can very light Yoga-motivated axiodilatons admit a completion above their apparent eV cutoff, and can their microscopic matter couplings generate source profiles compatible with solar-system gravity tests?

sources.title: Recurrent axion stars collapse with dark radiation emission and their cosmological constraints

evidence.text: Can repeated formation, growth, and collapse of axion stars in dense minihalos convert enough cold dark matter into relativistic axions to constrain axion mass and attractive self-coupling independently of Standard Model couplings?

sources.title: Pulsar Timing Array signature from oscillating metric perturbations due to ultra-light axion

evidence.text: How does the axion equation of motion determine the phase of pressure-driven metric oscillations in nonlinear galactic dark matter, and what velocity-dependent signature could distinguish the resulting pulsar timing signal?

sources.title: A Minimal Axio-dilaton Dark Sector

evidence.text: Can a minimal axio-dilaton pair supply both dark matter through axion oscillations and dark energy through the dilaton, while respecting solar-system constraints, and what cosmological signatures follow from their kinetic interaction?

sources.title: Screened axio-dilaton cosmology: novel forms of early dark energy

evidence.text: Can an axio-dilaton model with locally screened dilaton forces produce viable dynamical dark energy, and what early dark energy, CMB and structure-growth effects follow from the axion-matter couplings needed for screening?

sources.title: Freezing-in the Axiverse

evidence.text: How many light axions can be produced through independent Standard Model interactions, and how do operator dimension, flavor structure and reheating determine their contribution to ΔNeff and CMB discovery prospects?

sources.title: Cosmology of axion dark energy in supersymmetric models and constraints on high-scale parameters

evidence.text: Can a single axionic dark-energy field with multiple cosine harmonics and a Lagrangian interaction with scalar dark matter fit cosmological data, constrain high-scale axion parameters, and alter the Hubble tension or dark-energy evolution?

sources.title: Axiverse Lampposts

evidence.text: How do hierarchical instanton potentials and statistical multi-axion mixing organize field ranges, Standard Model couplings, inflationary relic abundances, and experimental targets after conditioning on the observed dark matter abundance?

sources.title: Bounding axion dark energy

evidence.text: What analytic restrictions relate axion couplings, initial conditions and the duration of declining cosmic acceleration, and what do these imply for axion dark energy when observational endpoints and the axionic weak gravity conjecture are imposed?

sources.title: Wading the String Bog: CMB Birefringence in the Swampland

evidence.text: Could CMB birefringence distinguish rolling ultralight axions from thin vacuum interfaces, and thereby test axionic Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC) expectations?

sources.title: A Multi-Axion Ladder Across Cosmic History: From Inflation, BBN, and Early Dark Energy to Late-Time Accelerated Expansion

evidence.text: Can a hierarchy of displaced axion-like fields generate successive homogeneous energy-density features during BBN, around matter–radiation equality and at late times, while leaving small transient remnants? How could expansion-history observations test further axion contributions?

sources.title: Helical Inflation and Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a two-axion helical trajectory produce a super-Planckian effective field range, and can departures from quadratic inflation or a subdominant cosmic-string B-mode component reveal the underlying axionic scenario?

sources.title: Warping the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a single open-string axion in a warped compactification have a super-Planckian decay constant consistently with the Weak Gravity Conjecture, and can the resulting construction support large-field inflation with observable primordial tensors?

sources.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Can a previously proposed type IIB axion potential produce sufficient small-field inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, and what low inflation and reheating scales follow?

sources.title: Constraints on small-field axion inflation

evidence.text: How do decay constants determine observables, inflaton masses, reheating temperatures, and dark-matter production in tuned small-field axion potentials? Which decay constants survive BBN and QCD-axion isocurvature constraints?

sources.title: The inflated Chern-Simons number in spectator chromo-natural inflation

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically interesting spectator chromo-natural inflation generate its required large quantized axion–gauge coupling through clockwork, while retaining observational agreement and calculational control? What additional restrictions follow from perturbative unitarity and conjectural quantum-gravity conditions?

sources.title: Helical Inflation and Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: The authors report numerical evolution with canonical kinetic terms and evaluate ns = 1 − 6ε + 2η and r = 16ε along the inflationary direction. They also eliminate the field in favor of r and a deviation parameter to organize slow-roll spectral observables.

sources.title: Drifting Oscillations in Axion Monodromy

evidence.text: MultiNest nested sampling searches the multimodal likelihood. Featureless-spectrum simulations estimate look-elsewhere improvements, while injected oscillatory spectra test signal recovery.

sources.title: Lattice QCD and Axion Cosmology

evidence.text: Heatbath ensembles permit large volumes and short autocorrelation times in pure glue. Susceptibility is obtained from the volume-normalized connected variance of topological charge, with an infinite-volume limit in its definition.

sources.title: Warping the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Estimate probe backreaction by comparing local stress-energy contributions of the wrapped D5-brane and source D3-branes. For the resolved conifold, approximate the warped volume using the smeared, l=0 warp-factor mode.

sources.title: Axion Cosmology

evidence.text: Background Klein–Gordon evolution is treated with exact Bessel-function solutions for power-law expansion, numerical integration when components compete, and a late-time WKB approximation.

sources.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Slow-roll estimates use ε=(Vφ/V)²/2, η=Vφφ/V, ns=1+2η−6ε and r=16ε. Numerical field trajectories and e-fold evolution illustrate selected plateaus; local derivative estimates explain the approximate dependence on f.

sources.title: Dark Matter Axions Revisited

evidence.text: For which Peccei–Quinn scale fa, inflationary Hubble parameter HI and initial angle θi can invisible axions supply all cold dark matter, including corrections from potential anharmonicity?

sources.title: Relic Abundance of Dark Photon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can energy initially stored in a misaligned axion produce the observed abundance of very light massive-vector dark matter through tachyonic amplification, including masses far below those efficiently populated by inflationary fluctuations?

sources.title: Dark Photon Dark Matter Produced by Axion Oscillations

evidence.text: Can coherent axion oscillations produce cold dark-photon dark matter through a tachyonic instability while visible-sector interactions eliminate the residual axion without violating cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Astrophysical aspects of string compactifications

evidence.text: Can an axion gradient, generated by different effective minima inside and outside a neutron star, screen the macroscopic Brans–Dicke coupling of a kinetically coupled dilaton? The immediate task is numerical stellar profiles and a diagnostic for subsequent screening measurement.

sources.title: Axion homeopathy: screening dilaton interactions

evidence.text: Can a light axion with very weak matter coupling use curved target-space interactions to screen a gravitational-strength dilaton coupling sufficiently to evade solar-system post-Newtonian constraints?

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can an axion oscillating about a positive minimum produce observable departures from constant dark energy? The proposed low-redshift comparison concerns masses comparable to the present Hubble rate.

sources.title: Non-gaussianity in axion N-flation models: detailed predictions and mass spectra

evidence.text: What probability distributions and correlations of the scalar tilt, tensor ratio, bispectrum and trispectrum arise in axion N-flation, and how tightly must unequal masses be packed to satisfy the observational constraints used in the paper?

sources.title: Search for solar Kaluza-Klein axions in theories of low scale quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can a terrestrial detector observe solar Kaluza–Klein (KK) axions through coincident two-photon decays, and what coupling sensitivity and existing limits follow in low-scale quantum-gravity models?

sources.title: Multiple-axion framework

evidence.text: Can a systematic treatment of many-axion potentials identify their vacuum structure and support metastability, inflation, a small cosmological constant, and ultralight axion dark matter within one effective framework?

sources.title: Axion-photon-mixing dark matter conversion mediated by torsion mass constrained by the Barbero-Immirzi parameter

evidence.text: Can propagating torsion provide an Einstein–Cartan portal between photons and dark axions, and can Holst/Nieh–Yan couplings relate photon–axion conversion, torsion masses and the Barbero–Immirzi parameter?

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: A hidden strongly interacting sector is used to generate a dark-energy scale from the electroweak and Planck scales while furnishing an axion with the shift symmetry needed by the supergravity construction.

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Could an electroweak axion with a potential scale different from the dark-energy scale serve as ultralight matter? The paper raises this possibility but does not identify a viable mass and abundance regime.

sources.title: Axion Hilltops, Kahler Modulus Quintessence and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a coupling modulus supply the gradient missing at an axion hilltop, and can the resulting positive-energy motion describe dark energy within the effective theory of a supersymmetric AdS vacuum?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Which observations could probe the light axions discussed here? The source highlights substructure, superradiance, and direct-detection experiments as prospective channels sensitive to axion mass and decay constant.

sources.title: Widening the Axion Window via Kinetic and Stückelberg Mixings

evidence.text: Can kinetic and Stückelberg mixing widen effective axion decay constants beyond the intrinsic scales suggested by the original Lagrangian, yielding either a super-Planckian inflationary coupling or a smaller decay constant in the conventional axion dark-matter window?

sources.title: Axio-Chameleons: a novel string-friendly multi-field screening mechanism

evidence.text: Can two-derivative axion-dilaton interactions screen an extremely light Brans-Dicke scalar with microscopic coupling g of order unity, while retaining control of the low-energy theory and acceptable axion-matter phenomenology?

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can an ultralight periodic axion provide evolving dark energy when its potential minimum is not fixed to zero? Hubble friction delays motion until H approaches the axion mass, while the initial phase and vacuum offset affect subsequent evolution.

sources.title: The ALP miracle: unified inflaton and dark matter

evidence.text: Can one light axion-like particle account for both hilltop inflation and the observed dark matter through incomplete reheating, while satisfying CMB normalization, scalar tilt, small-scale structure and photon-coupling constraints?

Can an electroweak-instanton axion simultaneously explain quintessence dark energy and the historically reported CMB polarization rotation, while satisfying anomaly cancellation, perturbativity and equation-of-state constraints?
Can axion dynamics produce an intermediate kination era after reheating, and can its gravitational-wave signatures probe the expansion history, axion dark matter and baryogenesis?

Can axion models of early dark energy be embedded in quantum gravity, and how strongly does the axion weak gravity conjecture constrain their decay constants and cosmologically relevant energy fractions?

How can quantized axion couplings be measured, monopole-induced potentials be computed reliably, post-inflationary axion dark matter be predicted, and thermal friction be understood across cosmological regimes?
Can a single monodromic axion account for dark energy and isotropic cosmic birefringence while keeping its fundamental decay constant below the Planck scale?

A homogeneous ultralight axion can act as potential-dominated dark energy and rotate photon polarization through a Chern–Simons interaction. Its mass and photon coupling are independent effective parameters.

Can phenomenologically interesting spectator chromo-natural inflation generate its required large quantized axion–gauge coupling through clockwork, while retaining observational agreement and calculational control? What additional restrictions follow from perturbative unitarity and conjectural quantum-gravity conditions?

Can very light Yoga-motivated axiodilatons admit a completion above their apparent eV cutoff, and can their microscopic matter couplings generate source profiles compatible with solar-system gravity tests?

Can repeated formation, growth, and collapse of axion stars in dense minihalos convert enough cold dark matter into relativistic axions to constrain axion mass and attractive self-coupling independently of Standard Model couplings?

How does the axion equation of motion determine the phase of pressure-driven metric oscillations in nonlinear galactic dark matter, and what velocity-dependent signature could distinguish the resulting pulsar timing signal?

Can a minimal axio-dilaton pair supply both dark matter through axion oscillations and dark energy through the dilaton, while respecting solar-system constraints, and what cosmological signatures follow from their kinetic interaction?

Can an axio-dilaton model with locally screened dilaton forces produce viable dynamical dark energy, and what early dark energy, CMB and structure-growth effects follow from the axion-matter couplings needed for screening?

How many light axions can be produced through independent Standard Model interactions, and how do operator dimension, flavor structure and reheating determine their contribution to ΔNeff and CMB discovery prospects?

Can a single axionic dark-energy field with multiple cosine harmonics and a Lagrangian interaction with scalar dark matter fit cosmological data, constrain high-scale axion parameters, and alter the Hubble tension or dark-energy evolution?

How do hierarchical instanton potentials and statistical multi-axion mixing organize field ranges, Standard Model couplings, inflationary relic abundances, and experimental targets after conditioning on the observed dark matter abundance?

What analytic restrictions relate axion couplings, initial conditions and the duration of declining cosmic acceleration, and what do these imply for axion dark energy when observational endpoints and the axionic weak gravity conjecture are imposed?
Could CMB birefringence distinguish rolling ultralight axions from thin vacuum interfaces, and thereby test axionic Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC) expectations?

Can a hierarchy of displaced axion-like fields generate successive homogeneous energy-density features during BBN, around matter–radiation equality and at late times, while leaving small transient remnants? How could expansion-history observations test further axion contributions?

evidence.text: The current is obtained from gauge-invariant point-split two-point functions and Pauli–Villars subtraction. evidence.text: Normal ordering in time-dependent adiabatic ladder operators subtracts the vacuum two-point function: the renormalized bilinear contains |φ|²−|φad|². The paper uses leading-order adiabatic modes; subtraction is necessary for the electric response to vanish as m→∞.
